ns0:metadata.ns0:title: Evaluate to true if the unix-def:file_test is properly supported
ns0:metadata.ns0:description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the unix-def:file_test.

ns0:notes.ns0:note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

ns0:criterion.comment: Test that the file test is supported with filepath entity equal to a value.

ns3:file_test.comment: Expect 'true' with 1 item. Test that the file_object is supported with filepath entity equal to some value.

ns3:file_object.comment: Retrieve a file_item with the filepath equal to '/opt/support/txt/txtfile/build.win32.txt'.

ns3:file_state.comment: This state represents a file_item with the filepath equal to '/opt/support/txt/txtfile/build.win32.txt'.
